scientific_integrity: A proof by singly and doubly marked incidence spaces, an irreducible A2 cusp boundary, isolated pure transpositions, and group conjugation. Exact modulo-101 discriminant witnesses certify necessary nonempty conditions but do not alone prove the infinite monodromy theorem.
scientific_limitations: Generic universal characteristic-zero coefficients only; not a specialization theorem; branch-parameter monodromy, not homological or line-scheme monodromy. Independent audit not performed.
title: Independent symmetric monodromy of the three genus-one discriminants of a triquadratic K3 surface
